CoAVolFog integration in WarcraftXL, updated 2026-10-01

Upstream: https://github.com/jealous-sound/coa-vfog
Revision: 4e31ddf53a326ba9c0ad03488b4c30f7ce23c969
Source license: GPL-3.0-only. LICENSE and the original README.md are retained.
The README contains upstream's GPLv3 section 7 additional permission concerning
combination with the World of Warcraft client; retain it with redistribution.
UPSTREAM.json records original file hashes and which files were adapted.

Local changes:
- fog_data.cpp/.h: bounded in-memory loading from a Windows DLL resource.
- renderer.cpp: allow the readable depth texture to supply its description when
  WXL has temporarily unbound its depth surface for an ordered render pass.
- WXL's VFogPass adapter, CMake rules and tests live outside this vendor tree.

The imported subset contains fog ray marching, temporal filtering, compositing,
noise, optional shafts, configuration helpers, fog/water data readers and the
Forever FFT/stencil water renderer and shaders, authored noise, unit-contact
capture, ripple simulation, local-light capture, and supporting depth/fog-fit code.
Upstream's loader, D3D wrapper, detours and overlay are not installed or built.
WXL retains device, hook, frame ordering and reset ownership.

Data provenance (not a claim of new ownership of Blizzard-derived data):
- fogdata.bin is upstream's converted Classic light, time-key and zone-outline
  dataset. The retained convert_classic_fog.py describes its source format.
- waterdata.bin is upstream's converted WoW Forever liquid presets, FFT tile
  parameters and foam masks. The retained convert_forever_water.py validates
  the original kit manifest when regenerating the data.
The updated fog kit is WoW Forever build 1.60.1.70009, format 4, including authored
noise, glow and grading curves. Both binary datasets are copied byte-for-byte from
the pinned revision. The
source license does not by itself establish independent rights in third-party
game assets. This local test package retains upstream's data and provenance.

Current integration limits:
Native distance fog is temporarily suppressed during eligible world frames after
a successful early fog frame, and the upstream replacement distance layer is
enabled. Original ranges feed fog/water inputs and are restored at world exit.
Warm-up, disabled, underwater and unsupported contexts retain native fog.
Local point lights are read through the upstream guarded native capture and fed
to fog; WXL's interior classification and continuous blend overwrite its interior
classification. Capture rejection supplies no lights rather than stale data.
Interior classification uses WXL's existing WMO classifier; enclosed fog receives
the native continuous interior blend through a guarded WXL adapter. The approved
pre-screen-effects candidate supplies native glow compensation only at that early
boundary; the late fallback keeps it zero. Forever water uses WXL-owned pre/post-liquid depth copies
and existing material/DIP hooks, rather than the upstream wrapper. Enclosed
water uses the interior preset to suppress outdoor sunlight. The surface stays
flat, as upstream; legacy displaced-wave volume effects yield on those frames.
Unit contacts use the upstream bounded, guarded reader and WXL's existing liquid
callback. The native splash sprites remain enabled, avoiding upstream's global
sprite suppression outside the simulated region. New controls use the independent
wxl-vfog-effects.ini; previous fog/water preference schemas remain unchanged.
The upstream MSAA wrapper, transparent-batch hooks, Forever glow and grading
integration are not enabled by this update. Compiled support code is not a claim
that these features are integrated. Existing WXL device/reset ownership remains.
Prior fog/water received user gameplay acceptance through WXL source e37682b.
This updated renderer, noise, ripples and fog lighting require fresh live acceptance.
No full upstream parity or universal map/material/driver coverage is claimed.

October 1 follow-up: WXL now consumes authored grading curves through its existing
retail-grading owner. NativeForeverGlow.hpp and ForeverGlowPolicy.hpp adapt the
pinned engine.cpp guard bytes and forever_look.cpp blend/restore behaviour under
this repository's GPL terms. No upstream hook or device wrapper is installed.
These WXL adapters are outside this unchanged-upstream-file hash manifest.
